questions.description: Read constraints, data types, and input sizes until there are zero assumptions left in your head.
Explicitly recognized the core algorithmic pattern before touching the design.
Stepped through the base example test case manually to understand the flow.
Wrote out structural logic, state transitions, and pointer movements on paper before coding.
Invented your own non-trivial test case and manually traced it step-by-step through your planned paper logic.
Explicitly tested boundaries (empty inputs, single elements, negative numbers, duplicates, max constraints)
Mathematically derived and noted down the Time Complexity before submitting.
Mathematically derived and noted down the Space Complexity before submitting.
All test cases passed within a maximum of 3 attempts, successfully resolving any initial syntax or edge-case bugs.
Problem submitted successfully on the first try without guessing or trial-and-error patching.
Code Quality Score by Gemini was more than 90%.
